A_weight_layout.exact_total_bytes_method: Sum of the 5 shard files' exact byte sizes as reported by the HF tree API's file listing at the pinned revision -- this is the most authoritative figure (real on-disk file sizes), not a parameter-count derivation.
A_weight_layout.index_json_vs_tree_sum_delta_note: model.safetensors.index.json's internal metadata.total_size field is itself a parameter-count-derived figure written by the original save_pretrained() call, not a re-measurement of actual file bytes -- it differs from the tree API's summed real file sizes by 46,056 bytes (per-shard safetensors header/padding overhead not counted in total_size). The tree-API sum (16,381,516,776 bytes) is treated as authoritative for 'exact bytes on disk'.
A_weight_layout.duplicate_format_note: No .bin PyTorch files, no consolidated single-file alternative format present in the pinned-revision tree -- exactly one BF16 safetensors representation exists.
A_weight_layout.native_stored_dtype_source: config.json torch_dtype field at the pinned revision

hf_api_safetensors_expand_field.clarification: This HF API field ('total': 8190735360) is a PARAMETER COUNT (8,190,735,360 parameters), not a byte count. It must not be confused with the exact_total_bytes_one_model_representation figure above. Multiplying 8,190,735,360 params x 2 bytes/param (BF16) = 16,381,470,720 bytes -- matching the index.json's total_size exactly, confirming that field is parameter-arithmetic-derived rather than an independent file-size measurement. Only the tree-API summed shard bytes (16,381,516,776) reflect actual on-disk file sizes including safetensors header/padding overhead.
